line.title: Open your line
line.hint: A queue is what guests join. Create one and your join link works.

hours.title: Set your opening hours
hours.hint: Until you do, walk-ins can join at any time of day and nobody can book online.

team.title: Invite a teammate
team.hint: Staff call the next guest from their own phone.

screen.title: Pair a screen
screen.hint: Show who is being called on a TV or tablet. Optional.

poster.title: Print the poster
poster.hint: Put the QR code where guests walk in.

firstTest.title: Try it yourself in a minute
firstTest.intro: Join your own line from a phone, then call yourself. It shows you what your guests see.
firstTest.doneIntro: A guest joined and was called. This is what your guests will see.

open.title: Open your join link on your phone
open.hint: Scan the QR code or open the link.

join.title: Join the line
join.hint: Enter any name and tap Join.

call.title: Call yourself from the console
call.hint: Open the console and call the next guest.
